value.title: Chainglass PA rounds: what is and isn't a trigger

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Chainglass PA, stood up 2026-11-10 for prime pij-outer-bobcat. Most rounds are "nothing to do"; that is correct, send nothing.

- Exempt: the prime and pij-lonely-antelope (retiring prime, 247k, cold). Its "idle, quiet" and stale-card lines repeat every nudge; ignore them.
- Stale card is a trigger only on a seat that is WORKING (or owes a card). Idle/done/prime/PA seats: no. Send the `pij report now` line once; it worked (liquid-carp refreshed its card). Never to a cold seat.
- pij-extended-bison: unknown seat, idle, no parent. Do not wake; tell the prime if it starts working.
- No seat ever neared 600k during my tenure (max worker 234k, prime 214k), so no compaction was needed.
- Fleet membership churns (workers and a second PA, pij-funny-alligator, appeared mid-day): the prime seats them; don't touch.
- Repo rules in chainglass-governance/.harness/government/RULINGS.md: text-only questions, never touch `just dev`, never capture-pane unless the PA brief's unsent-text/dialog case, never write ~/pi-hacking/pij.
- The "no turn for N hours" wake fires after quiet overnight stretches; it is not an alarm if the fleet was idle.
